data.name: High On Life VR
data.detailed_description:
Step into the outrageous universe of High On Life VR, where fast-paced action, unforgettable characters, and absurd humor collide in a fully immersive virtual reality experience.

Explore vibrant alien worlds, battle bizarre enemies, and wield an arsenal of unique, talking weapons as you embark on an intergalactic adventure unlike anything you've experienced before. Designed specifically for VR, every encounter puts you at the center of the action with immersive interactions, dynamic combat, and engaging exploration.

Discover hidden secrets, upgrade your arsenal, overcome challenging encounters, and experience the distinctive humor and style that made High On Life a fan favorite. Whether you're engaging in frantic firefights or exploring colorful environments, every moment is designed to make you feel like you're truly part of the adventure.

Features

• Fully immersive VR gameplay

• Fast-paced first-person action

• Explore colorful alien worlds

• Unique weapons with unforgettable personalities

• Action-packed combat and exploration

• Hidden collectibles and secrets

• Built for virtual reality

Wishlist High on Life VR and prepare for an unforgettable sci-fi adventure.

data.short_description: High On Life VR drops you into a hilarious first-person action adventure where humanity's fate hangs on your outrageous talking guns. Battle bizarre aliens, explore vibrant worlds, and uncover hidden secrets, now rebuilt for immersive virtual reality.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X or greater
  • Memory: 5 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX 480 or greater
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR, Meta Quest 2+3+3S, Index, Pimax, Index Knuckles, Pico.
  • Additional Notes: Vive Controllers are NOT supported.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X or greater
  • Memory: 5 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 2070 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT or greater
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR, Meta Quest 2+3+3S, Index, Pimax, Index Knuckles, Pico.
  • Additional Notes: Vive Controllers are NOT supported.
